blocks.markdown:
One year later in 1989,

“Quinty” was done.

Tajiri established Game Freak

for the launch of “Quinty.”

I quit the company which I was working for

and entered Game Freak.

blocks.markdown:

Because game development was just fun.

And I’m loving it.

It was the only reason.
